description: This file defines a React component for a tree view UI, including types, state management, rendering logic, and interaction handling for hierarchical data display.

classes.name: TreeItem
classes.description: Type representing a tree node with id, parent, and children.

classes.name: TreeState
classes.description: Type representing the state of expanded items in the tree.

classes.name: TreeViewProps
classes.description: Generic type for properties passed to the TreeView component, including rendering and interaction callbacks.

classes.name: TreeItemHeader
classes.description: React component for rendering individual tree items with expand/collapse and selection features.

classes.name: TreeItemData
classes.description: Type for internal indexing of tree nodes, including depth, expansion state, and sibling links.

methods.name: TreeView
methods.description: Main React component rendering the hierarchical tree structure with keyboard and mouse interactions.

methods.description: Function to index tree nodes for efficient rendering and navigation, including sibling links and depth.
